We help build software and design data platforms, manage large volumes of client data, develop compliance procedures for data management, and continually research new technologies to drive innovation and sustainable change.
   

  

**Job Position Title:**
 IN\_Senior Associate\_Sr. ReactNative Developer\_AppTech\_Advisory\_KOLKATA (immediate joiners)
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
 We are looking to hire multiple (Fulltime) Senior ReactNative Developer across PwC India locations in India.
   

  

 Below the job responsibilities.
   

  

 Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native for both Android and iOS platforms.
   

  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including designers, backend engineers, and product managers to define, design, and ship new features.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
* Build reusable components and front\-end libraries for future use.
* Implement native modules and bridge code when required, especially for platform\-specific features (iOS skills are a plus).

* Integrate third\-party APIs and SDKs seamlessly with the mobile application.
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and contribute to best practices and continuous improvements.


**Mandatory skill sets:**
* 4\+ years of professional experience in mobile application development.
* Strong expertise in React Native, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Familiarity with React Native navigation, state management (Redux / Context API), and Hooks.

* Strong understanding of mobile development lifecycle, app store submission processes, and CI/CD workflows.
* Proficient with debugging, testing (unit, integration), and performance tuning of mobile apps.
* Experience with common front\-end development libraries such as Node, Webpack etc.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements
* A knack for benchmarking and optimization
* Familiarity with code versioning tools such as Git


**Preferred skill sets:**
 Relevant certification related to mobile application preferred.
   

  

**Years of experience required:**
 4\-7 years of professional experience in mobile application development with ReactNative.
   

  

**Education qualification:**
 B.E. / B.Tech / MCA/ M.E/ M.TECH/ MBA/ PGDM. All qualifications should be in regular full\-time mode with no extension of course duration due to backlogs.

title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Responsive**
 Responsive, formerly RFPIO, is the market leader in a growing category of SaaS solutions called Strategic Response Management. More than 2,000 customers, including Google, Microsoft, Blackrock, T.Rowe Price, Adobe, Amazon, Visa and Zoom, are using the Responsive platform to manage business critical responses \-including bids, questionnaires, assessments, and trust centers \- that impact nearly half of a company's revenue. More than 35% of cloud SaaS leaders and more than 20 of the Fortune 100 standardize on Responsive, and the company has been voted "best in class" by G2 for 24 quarters straight. Customers have used Responsive to close more than $750B in transactions to\-date. To learn more , visit responsive.io .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Responsive is looking for a Technical Lead who combines strong technical expertise with leadership skills to drive complex projects and mentor a team of engineers. In this role, you will take ownership of architecting scalable solutions, optimizing system performance, and ensuring engineering excellence. You will play a crucial role in guiding technical decisions, fostering innovation, and contributing to the growth of a top\-tier SaaS company in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

 We welcome candidates who thrive on ownership and accountability, and are driven to deliver results and make a meaningful impact.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship: Guide a team of engineers, provide technical direction, and establish best practices to drive high\-quality software development.
* Solution Architecture \& Design: Own the architecture and design of complex, distributed systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Hands\-on Development: Actively participate in coding, code reviews, and debugging critical issues while fostering a strong engineering culture.
* Full\-Stack Development: Design and develop robust backend solutions in Java while ensuring a seamless and efficient React\-based frontend experience.
* Performance Optimization: Identify and resolve system bottlenecks, ensuring efficient resource utilization and low\-latency responses.
* Cross\-Team Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across different teams to align technical solutions with business goals.
* Continuous Innovation: Stay updated with emerging technologies, evaluate new tools/frameworks, and drive adoption where beneficial.


****Education****
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of experience in software development, including designing and building large\-scale distributed systems.


****Knowledge \& Skills****
* Strong expertise in Java programming, Java design patterns, and high\-performance backend development.
* Proficiency in React for frontend development, with experience in state management (Redux, React Query, or Context API).
* Proven experience in designing and implementing scalable, fault\-tolerant architectures.
* Proficiency in multiple technologies such as Spring Boot, React, MongoDB, etc.
* Experience leading and mentoring engineering teams, conducting code reviews, and setting technical standards.
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native architecture, with hands\-on experience in platforms like GCP, Azure, or AWS.
* Expertise in search and retrieval technologies, including ElasticSearch, Apache Solr, or similar. Knowledge of AI\-driven search, NLP, and semantic search is a plus.
* Proficiency in Test Driven Development (TDD) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with experience handling production\-level challenges, performance tuning, and system optimization.
* Experience working in agile environments, with familiarity in Scrum and JIRA.
* Ability to balance hands\-on coding with strategic technical decision\-making.
* Experience in designing and implementing AI\-powered applications, including LLMs, RAG architectures, AI agents, and workflow automation solutions

title: AI Application Engineer
description:
**Job Title: AI Application Engineer**
 Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking AI Application Modernization Engineer to join our Digital Transformation team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer with deep expertise in legacy application modernization, AI\-assisted software development, and Microsoft cloud technologies.
   

  

 As AI Application Modernization Engineer, you will lead the transformation of mission\-critical business applications built on VB6 front\-end technologies and IBM i (AS400\) platforms, including Synon, RPG, RPGLE, and CLP. You will leverage AI and Generative AI technologies to accelerate code conversion, application modernization, testing, documentation, and deployment to modern Microsoft platforms.
   

  

 You will play a critical role in reducing technical debt, improving application maintainability, and accelerating JCI's digital transformation strategy through scalable, cloud\-ready solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
**AI\-Powered Application Modernization**
* Hands on application development to modernization of legacy applications built using VB6, Synon, RPG, RPGLE, CLP, and IBM i (AS400\) technologies.
* Utilize Generative AI, GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate code analysis, conversion, testing, and documentation.
* Design and execute migration strategies from legacy platforms to modern Microsoft technologies.
* Develop reusable modernization frameworks, patterns, and best practices for enterprise\-scale application transformation.


**Microsoft Development \& Cloud Engineering**
* Design and develop modern business applications using Microsoft technologies including C\#, .NET 8\+, ASP.NET Core, and .NET MAUI.
* Modernize desktop applications into cloud\-enabled and cross\-platform solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Design API\-first architectures and service\-based integrations using Azure services.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure and scalable solutions.


**AI Strategy \& Engineering Excellence**
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and Generative AI to improve software engineering productivity and modernization outcomes.
* Lead proof\-of\-concepts and pilots demonstrating AI\-driven modernization capabilities.
* Establish engineering standards, governance, and best practices for AI\-assisted application development.
* Mentor development teams on modernization approaches, AI tools, and Microsoft development platforms.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 5\+ years of software development experience.
* 5\+ years of experience with VB6 application development and maintenance.
* Proven experience modernizing legacy applications to Microsoft technologies.
* Experience delivering large\-scale application modernization or migration programs.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted software development tools and Generative AI technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise business\-critical applications and complex integrations.


**Technical Expertise**
**Front\-End Technologies \-** 
 Visual Basic 6 (VB6\), C\#, .NET Framework, .NET 8\+, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, WinUI, WPF, XAML, HTML5, JavaScript
   

  

**Back\-End Technologies**
 Synon (CA 2E), RPG, RPGLE, CLP, IBM i / AS400, DB2, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, API Development
   

  

**AI \& Modernization Technologies**
 Azure OpenAI
 **,** 
 GitHub Copilot Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, AI\-assisted code conversion tools, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
   

  

**Cloud \& DevOps**
 Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Power Platform, CI/CD Pipelines
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience converting VB6 applications to .NET MAUI, WinUI, or modern Microsoft technologies.
* Experience modernizing Synon, RPG, RPGLE, or AS400 applications.
* Experience with Azure\-based application modernization programs.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application rationalization, and technical debt reduction strategies.
* Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or enterprise ERP environments.
* Microsoft Azure certifications preferred.


**Ideal Candidate:** 
 An engineer who has successfully delivered VB6 and AS400 modernization programs and has leveraged AI technologies to accelerate application conversion to modern Microsoft platforms such as .NET, MAUI, Azure, and Power Platform.

title: Frontend Developer
description:
While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth.
   

  

 If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you\- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi!
   

  

**Job Overview**
 We are looking for a talented and creative Frontend Developer with 3–4 years of professional experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in UI/UX implementation, Next.js, WordPress, Tailwind CSS, modern CSS, web animations, and 3D web experiences.
   

  

 You will be responsible for transforming design concepts and Figma files into pixel\-perfect, responsive, high\-performance websites, while ensuring excellent usability, visual quality, and cross\-browser compatibility.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Convert Figma/UI designs into pixel\-perfect, responsive frontend websites.
* Develop modern, scalable, and reusable frontend components using Next.js and React.js.
* Build responsive interfaces using Tailwind CSS, CSS3, HTML5, and modern frontend practices.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to ensure accurate implementation of design systems, layouts, typography, colors, spacing, and interactions.
* Create smooth and engaging web animations and micro\-interactions.
* Develop visually impressive 3D objects and interactive 3D web experiences.
* Optimize websites for performance, responsiveness, accessibility, and SEO.
* Develop and customize websites using WordPress, including theme customization and frontend integration.
* Ensure websites work consistently across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-structured code.
* Identify and resolve UI, layout, performance, and browser compatibility issues.
* Conduct testing and debugging across different browsers and devices.
* Work closely with designers, backend developers, and project managers to deliver projects on time.
* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in frontend development, UI/UX, animation, and 3D web development.


**Required Skills**
* 3–4 years of experience in frontend/web development.
* Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web design.
* Hands\-on experience with React.js and Next.js.
* Strong expertise in Tailwind CSS and modern CSS techniques.
* Excellent understanding of UI/UX principles and design implementation.
* Proven ability to convert Figma designs into production\-ready websites.
* Experience with web animations and interactive interfaces.
* Knowledge or hands\-on experience in 3D object creation and 3D web experiences.
* Strong experience with WordPress frontend development and customization.
* Understanding of REST APIs and frontend/backend integration.
* Familiarity with Git/version control systems.
* Strong attention to detail and a passion for creating visually polished websites.
* Good understanding of website performance optimization and responsive design.


**Good to Have**
* Experience with Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, Framer Motion, or similar animation/3D technologies.
* Experience working with 3D models, lighting, materials, textures, and interactive 3D elements.
* Experience with WordPress page builders, custom themes, or headless WordPress.
* Basic understanding of SEO and Core Web Vitals.
* Experience working with design systems and reusable component libraries.
* Understanding of accessibility standards and WCAG.


**What We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who combines strong technical frontend skills with a great eye for design. You should be comfortable taking a Figma design and independently turning it into a polished, responsive, animated, and production\-ready website.
   

  

 If you are passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences and enjoy working at the intersection of design, development, animation, and 3D, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us* 
*!*

title: React Native Developer
description:
**Job Summary**
 Sr Software Engineer will design and build high quality mobile and web applications for consumer lending products working in a hybrid day shift model. The role focuses on robust app architecture secure Rest API integration and performant user experiences using React Js and React Native while ensuring reliable delivery through GIT based collaboration and adherence to domain compliance and risk standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and architect scalable mobile applications for consumer lending solutions ensuring robust modular structures that support maintainable code and future feature growth
* Develop and enhance responsive user interfaces using React Js and React Native that deliver intuitive borrowing experiences while meeting accessibility and performance expectations
* Implement secure and well structured Rest API integrations that enable reliable data exchange between mobile clients and backend services with strong focus on consumer lending workflows
* Configure and optimize networking library usage to ensure resilient connectivity graceful error handling and efficient data transfer across diverse mobile and web environments
* Collaborate with product and domain experts to translate consumer lending requirements into technical designs that balance regulatory constraints operational risk and customer usability
* Apply version control best practices using GIT including branching merging and code review workflows to maintain high code quality and predictable release cycles in a hybrid work setting
* Conduct thorough unit integration and end to end testing of mobile and web features focusing on loan origination repayment and account management scenarios to prevent defects in production
* Investigate and resolve production issues by analyzing logs monitoring performance metrics and applying networking and API debugging techniques to restore stable experiences for lending customers
* Optimize application performance by profiling rendering flows reducing payload sizes and tuning caching strategies to support fast secure and responsive interactions for borrowers and internal teams
* Document architecture design decisions and technical implementation details in clear consumable formats so cross functional peers can understand lending flows and maintain solutions effectively
* Coordinate with security and compliance stakeholders to embed encryption validation and data protection practices into mobile architecture aligning with consumer lending regulations and organizational risk guidelines
* Mentor peers on best practices for React React Native Rest API design and mobile architecture patterns fostering a culture of clean code shared ownership and continuous improvement across the engineering group
* Participate actively in sprint planning backlog refinement and hybrid collaboration rituals to ensure delivery commitments are realistic aligned with lending business priorities and technically achievable


**Qualifications**
* Bring hands on experience in designing and implementing mobile app architecture using modern patterns such as component based structures and navigation strategies suited for complex lending journeys
* Demonstrate advanced proficiency with Rest API design and consumption including request modeling response handling and error management tailored to secure financial data exchanges
* Show strong capability in working with networking libraries to manage timeouts retries connectivity detection and secure transport enhancing reliability of mobile and web channels
* Exhibit solid skills in React Js for building modular front end components state management and routing that support rich data driven lending dashboards and workflows
* Apply deep experience with React Native to deliver high performing cross platform mobile applications leveraging native modules when needed to enrich borrower experiences
* Use GIT fluently for collaborative development including pull requests conflict resolution and release tagging ensuring stable progression of code across environments
* Leverage practical knowledge of consumer lending concepts including credit assessment loan lifecycle repayment schedules and regulatory considerations to design domain aware technical solutions
